title: マチカネフクキタルからの提案

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've been gathering members, and the team is really starting to take shape. One day…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I received a message from the great Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was told to pray for our team's peace and prosperity!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In other words, we should put up a calligraphy piece with a motivational message!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After making her sudden declaration, Matikanefukukitaru dashes out of my office just as suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In other words, you should take this suggestion for our team name!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The name is: "Sunny Runners"! How does that sound? You should really, really consider it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That might be a good team name! I'll have to make note of it.
